 ( individually , or in the case of J oint Buyers, collectively referred to as “ Buyer ”, which expression shall, where the context so admits, mean and include his/her or their respective heirs, executors, administrators, Nominees, successors-in-interest, permitted transferees and permitted assigns) of the OTHER PART . 
 WHEREAS 
 
 The Developer is the owner of a real estate project named and styled as ‘ ZAMEEN OPAL ’ consisting of residential apartments located at Plot No. 16 and 17, Land Breeze Society, Raiwind Road, Lahore (“ Project ”); 
 
 The Buyer has seen the Project and desires to purchase the fully constructed apartment together with all the White Goods , as more fully described in the Description of Purchased Unit and Appendix C ( together with the “ Purchased Unit ”) ; and 
 
 The Developer has agreed to sell , and the Buyer has agree d to purchase, the Purchased Unit on the terms and conditions of this Agreement to Sell. 
 
 NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree to the following terms and conditions: 
 
 SCOPE AND INTERPRETATION 
 
 For the consideration provided in this Agreement to Sell (defined below), including without limitation the full Purchase Price, the Developer agrees to sell the Purchased Unit to the Buyer, and the Buyer agrees to purchase the Purchased Unit from the Developer, along with all rights, title and interest s of the Developer therein , strictly in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement along with all documents attached hereto, as may be amended from time to time. Provided that where there is more than one person or entity as the “Buyer”, then the obligations of the persons or entities in relation hereto shall be joint and several. 
 
 The following documents (duly acknowledged) together shall constitute the complete and exclusive agreement between the Parties hereto in respect of the sale and purchase of the Purchased Unit, all of which shall form an integral part of the Agreement (the “Agreement” ): 
 
 This Agreement to Sell; 
 Schedule A: Description of Purchased Unit &amp; Nominees Form ; 
 Schedule B: General Terms and Conditions hereof ; 
 License Agreement; 
 A ppendix A : Payment Plan; 
 Appendix B: Purchased Unit Floor Plan; 
 Appendix C: Inventory of White Goods ; and 
 Any other document forming part of the Agreement by reference herein pursuant to the terms and conditions thereof. 
 
 The documents enumerated in Clause 2 above shall be taken as mutually explanatory, and in the event of any conflict, ambiguity or discrepancy, unless otherwise specified, priority shall be given to the General Terms and Conditions, followed by the Payment Plan, and Description of Purchased Unit. Any terms used as defined terms shall have the meaning assigned to them in the General Terms and Conditions. The rules of interpretation set out in the General Terms and Conditions shall apply to all documents forming the Agreement. 
 
 BUYER’S WARRANTIES 
 
 The Buyer confirms having read, understood and agrees to comply with the Agreement at all times and by any further terms and conditions as may be prescribed from time to time by the Developer . 
 
 The Buyer represents and warrants that all details provided by the Buyer in this Agreement are true and correct in all respects. 
 
 The Buyer represents and warrants that the Buyer (and where there is more than one Buyer, each such Buyer) has the requisite capacity and authority to enter into the Agreement and to perform the obligations hereunder. 
 
 ARBITRATION 
 
 Any dispute or difference as to the Agreement or any part thereof or any matter or thing of whatsoever nature arising thereunder or in relation thereto between the Developer and the Buyer that cannot be resolved through mutual agreement shall be referred to arbitration in accordance with the General Terms and Conditions.

 SCHEDULE B 
 GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS 
 
 DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION 
 Unless inconsistent with the context, the following words will have the meanings assigned below: 
 
 Agreement means the Agreement to Sell, including these General Terms and Conditions as well as all documents enumerated in Clause 2 of the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 Agreement to Sell means the Agreement to Sell entered into between the Developer and the Buyer to which these General Terms and Conditions are appended. 
 
 Buyer means the person or persons identified as the Buyer in the Agreement to Sell and his/her or their respective heirs, executors, administrators, successors, permitted transferees and permitted assigns. Where there is more than one Buyer, references to one Buyer shall be to such persons jointly and severally. 
 
 Common Areas means those parts of the Project not physically forming a part of any Purchased Unit and are intended for the common use of all occupants or owners of all Purchased Units, including inter alia all open areas, elevators, administrative office areas, security system, lobbies, Parking Space and hallways. 
 
 Common Facilities means all roads, pavements, water features, installations, elevators, power backup equipment, security systems , tube-well motors, improvements and common assets of the Common Areas that are intended for facilitating all occupants and owners of Purchased Units and do not form part of any given Purchased Unit. 
 
 Competent Authority means any federal, provincial, capital or local government or authority, department, local, regulatory, statutory or housing authority and any other authority which has jurisdiction over any aspect or part of the Project or the Agreement. 
 
 Developer means D EEVAR DEVELOP ERS (PRIVATE) LIMITED , with its registered office at 94 B/I, M. M. Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore. 
 
 Down Payment means the down payment paid by the Buyer under the Agreement to Sell, as given in the Payment Plan or any other amount as agreed between the Parties in writing . 
 
 Due Date means the date on or before which any payment, including the payments mentioned in the Payment Plan, is required to be paid by the Buyer in the Developer’s designated bank account. 
 
 Event of Force Majeure has the meaning assigned to it in Clause REF _Ref98336344 \r \h \* MERGEFORMAT 14.1 of these General Terms and Conditions. 
 
 Instalment Payment means any payment (including Down Payment) to be made by the Buyer as per the Payment Plan. 
 
 License has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 5 . 1. 
 
 Management Company means the entity or entities, which may include the Developer, any of its affiliates or associated companies or any other company (and their respective successors in interest and assigns) charged with the responsibility of maintaining, operating or managing the Project or any part thereof, including, inter alia, the Parking Space, Common Areas and/or Common Facilities. 
 
 Nominee means next of kin or any other person nominated by the Buyer in Schedule A to facilitate in the process of transfer of rights and obligations of the Buyer, under the Agreement to Sell and/or with respect to the Purchased Unit, to the Buyer’s legal heirs, in the event of demise of the Buyer. 
 
 Parking Space means the parking space allocated for the exclusive use of the Buyer or occupants of the Purchased Unit . 
 
 Party refers to either one of the parties to this Agreement , whereas Parties refers to both. 
 
 Payment Plan means the Payment Plan in A ppendix A of the Agreement to Sell , setting out the Due Date, quantum and schedule of Installment Payments of the Purchase Price to be paid by the Buyer to the Developer . 
 
 Permitted Use means the permi tted nature and use of the Purchased Unit as a residential unit , strictly in accordance with the Rules (defined below) . 
 
 Project means the real estate project , named and styled as ‘ Zameen Opal ’, constructed and developed by the Developer at Plot No. 16 and 17, Land Breeze Society, Raiwind Road, Lahore . 
 
 Purchase Price means the total amount payable by the Buyer to purchase the Purchased Unit (exclusive of tax ) including White Goods (as specified in Appendix C ), in the manner and such instalments, as identified in the Payment Plan in Appendix A to the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 Purchased Unit means the fully constructed unit specifically described in Schedule A and shown in the Purchased Unit Floor Plan, including White Goods, which the Buyer has contracted to purchase pursuant to the Agreement. 
 
 Purchased Unit Floor 
 Plan means the floor plan of the Purchased Unit and its location, as shown in Appendix B to the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 Rules means such rules as may be framed by the Developer and/or the Management Company and amended from time to time setting out the Buyer’s (or anyone occupying the Purchased Unit other than the Buyer) rights and obligations in relation to the transfer/resale, use, occupancy, layout, maintenance, design and display of the Purchased Units. 
 
 Service Charges Advance means the Service Charges payable by the Buyer to the Management Company in advance on or before the date of grant of License under Clause 5 of the General Terms and Conditions . 
 
 Service Charges m eans the amount payable by the Buyer or occupants , in the designated bank account of the Management Company from time to time, for the use and upkeep of Common Areas, Common Facilities, and/or Parking Space s of the Project . 
 White Goods means the household appliances provided in the Purchased Unit(s) as specified in Appendix C. 
 
 
 1.2. Except where the context otherwise requires, references in the Agreement to: 
 An Article, Clause, attachment, or paragraph are reference to an Article, Clause, attachment or paragraph of the Agreement or the relevant document comprising the Agreement; 
 Any headings in the Agreement are for ease of reference only and are not to be taken into account in construction or interpretation; 
 Any statute or other legislative provision shall be read to include any statutory or legislative modification, amendment or re-enactment thereof; 
 Words denoting one gender shall include all other genders; 
 Words denoting singular shall, where the context permits, include plural; 
 Any reference to a date or time is to such date and time in Islamabad, Pakistan; 
 Any reference to a Party shall, where the context permits, mean and include its successors-in-interest and permitted assigns; 
 No rule of construction shall apply to the disadvantage of a Party because that Party was responsible for the preparation of the Agreement or any part of the Agreement; 
 Use of the terms “including”, “include” or “includes” shall be interpreted to be followed by the phrase “without limitation”, unless otherwise specified; 
 An obligation on a Party to do any act, matter or thing includes an obligation to procure that it is done and words placing a Party under a restriction include an obligation not to permit or allow infringement of the restriction. 
 “ the law” includes any law, by-law, regulation (including any rule, official directive, request or guideline), legislation (including delegated legislation), constitution, decree, judgment, court order/authority of competent jurisdiction, ordinance, statute, treaty or other legislative measure of any governmental body or any Competent Authority; 
 Where there is a reference to “sell”, “sale” or other transfer of rights in any Purchased Unit by the Developer to the Buyer, such term refers to a sale of the Developer’s rights relating to the Purchased Unit concerned, including the right to occupy and use such Purchased Unit and, where applicable, transfer those rights all upon and subject to the General Terms and Conditions. 
 SALE OF PURCHASED UNIT 
 
 2.1 The Developer agrees to sell the Purchased Unit to the Buyer, and the Buyer agrees to purchase the Purchased Unit from the Developer, along with all rights, title and interest of the Developer therein, for a total sale consideration equal to the Purchase Price strictly in accordance with the Agreement and the terms and conditions thereof. 
 
 2.2 The Buyer acknowledges and understands that only rights, title and interests in and to the Purchased Unit shall be transferred and conveyed to the Buyer, and the Buyer shall have no rights, title or interest s in and to any other part of the Project other than the limited access to Common Areas, Common Facilities and Parking Space as expressly provided herein. For the avoidance of doubt, the Developer shall at all times have all rights, title and interest s with respect to the Common Areas, Common Facilities, Parking Space, roof and exterior walls. 
 
 BUYER’S OBLIGATIONS 
 
 The sale and transfer o f right s , title and interest s in and to the Purchased Unit , and handing over of possession thereof, in favour of the Buyer and uninterrupted enjoyment of all amenities and facilities in relation thereto, shall be subject to the following: 
 Payment of each Instalment Payment by the Buyer on or before the relevant Due Date; 
 Payment of one - time Service Charges Advance by the Buyer as and when due ; 
 Payment of Service Charges to the Management Company as per applicable rates and due dates specified by the Management Company. The Developer will endeavour to make all reasonable efforts to determine Service Charges as per fair market rates ; 
 Payment by the Buyer of all, electricity, water, or other utility and meter connection and consumption charges, as and when due . In the event that any utilities are provided to the Buyer directly by the Management Company, such amounts will be in addition to the Service Charges or Service Charges Advance and the Buyer shall settle any such charges as per consumption or usage promptly when required to do so ; 
 Payment by the Buyer of all applicable taxes, fees, stamp duties, and levies (if any) related to the Purchased Unit as per Clause 4 below ; and 
 The Buyer agrees to abide by all Rules and all other rules or regulations prescribed by any Competent Authority as may be applicable with respect to the Purchased Unit.
